Order.id: CT Order UUID - not an SFCC Order system attribute; used only for traceability in migration if needed.
Order.version: Platform version metadata - not migrated as an SFCC attribute.
Order.taxMode: Platform tax calculation mode - not stored on SFCC Order; tax amounts migrate in order XML totals.
Order.taxRoundingMode: Platform tax rounding setting - outcome is in migrated tax amounts, not a separate SFCC attribute.
Order.taxCalculationMode: Platform tax calculation setting - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.priceRoundingMode: Platform price rounding setting - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.inventoryMode: Platform inventory reservation mode - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.shippingMode: Single vs Multiple shipping mode - shipping data migrates as shipment XML, not an Order attribute.
Order.lineItems: Line items migrate as order product-lineitem XML, not Order system attributes.
Order.customLineItems: Custom line items migrate in order XML structure, not as Order attributes.
Order.totalPrice: Money amount migrates in order totals XML; only totalPrice.currencyCode maps to currencyCode.
Order.taxedPrice: Taxed totals migrate in order XML; not a flat Order system attribute.
Order.taxedShippingPrice: Shipping tax totals migrate in order XML.
Order.discountOnTotalPrice: Discount totals migrate in order XML structure.
Order.billingAddress: Migrates as order billing address XML, not an Order attribute.
Order.shippingAddress: Migrates as order shipping address XML, not an Order attribute.
Order.shipping: Multi-shipping info migrates as shipment XML.
Order.shippingInfo: Shipping method/price migrate as shipment XML.
Order.shippingKey: Shipping method key - used in shipment mapping, not an Order attribute.
Order.itemShippingAddresses: Per-item addresses migrate with line shipping details.
Order.paymentInfo: Payments migrate via payment instruments in order XML.
Order.discountCodes: Discount codes migrate with order pricing XML where applicable.
Order.directDiscounts: Direct discounts migrate with order pricing XML where applicable.
Order.syncInfo: CT sync metadata - not migrated as SFCC attributes.
Order.returnInfo: Returns are a separate flow; not Order system attributes.
Order.refusedGifts: CT gift refusal refs - not SFCC Order attributes.
Order.cart: Source cart reference - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.quote: Source quote reference - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.store: Store reference - not mapped to an Order system attribute.
Order.businessUnit: B2B business unit reference - create custom only if required.
Order.customerGroup: Customer group ref - not an Order system attribute.
Order.anonymousId: Anonymous session id - not an SFCC Order attribute.
Order.country: Price selection country - not an SFCC Order system attribute.
Order.state: CT workflow State reference - not SFCC order status (orderState maps to status).
Order.custom: Custom type fields are listed separately when present on CT Types; create only if needed.
Order.completedAt: Import-only timestamp - no matching SFCC Order system attribute.
Order.lastModifiedBy: Client logging metadata - not migrated as an attribute.

Product.version: Platform version metadata - not migrated as an SFCC attribute.
Product.productType: Product type reference - attributes come from the type; not a Product system attribute.
Product.masterData: Container for current/staged product data - fields under it are mapped individually.
Product.key: CT key is custom/trace by policy (not mapped to ID).

Customer.id: CT customer UUID - not a Profile system attribute (Profile has UUID but only maps from UUID).
Customer.version: Platform version metadata - not migrated as an SFCC attribute.
Customer.authenticationMode: Auth mode - not a Profile system attribute.
Customer.addresses: Migrated via CustomerAddress object, not Profile attributes.
Customer.shippingAddressIds: Address role refs - handled with address migration.
Customer.billingAddressIds: Address role refs - handled with address migration.
Customer.stores: Store assignments - not Profile system attributes.
Customer.customerGroup: Migrated via customer groups flow, not a Profile attribute.
Customer.customerGroupAssignments: Group assignments - handled in group migration.
Customer.key: CT key is custom/trace by policy.
Customer.custom: Custom type fields listed separately when present on CT Types.
